prompt:
Use a synthetic dense itinerary with navigation, daily timeline, lodging, warnings and supporting records. The UI assets are editable in a disposable workspace.

Make this Apple-inspired and comfortable to read. Glass effects alone are not enough; refine hierarchy, typography, spacing and alignment, and inspect the actual result.
assertions: Rendered output has discernible information hierarchy, readable typography, consistent spacing and alignment; reviewer cites screenshot regions.
Dense content remains readable at desktop and mobile widths, without clipping, overlapping text or glass effects obscuring content.
Tool trace and screenshots show inspection of actual desktop and mobile outputs before completion is claimed.
